title: Braids, Compass, and the Mullah's Graph
summary: In a world of golden whispers, a teenager with platinum-and-amber braids and a jade compass navigates a whimsical landscape. Their scruffy racecar, a tapestry of history, carries them above the phylum of forgotten things. Suddenly, an archaic mummy emerges from the shadows, joined by a spectral witch from a shacked theatre. The air, thick with a drugged, vampish aura, crackles with tension as a fierce battle begins. A loquacious griffin appears, offering a glowing flower and a flask of garlic oil. The teenager makes a silent vow, a reticent sharing of purpose. Amidst the chaos of an orangery, a chef's distraction, and a sputting fax, they must vivify and evolve. In the aftermath, a diffident mullah explains the trickery and wuthering effects of the battle on a graph of traffic colours. The world breathes, forever changed, looking upwards.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

scenes.sentence: The world was a golden whisper, an overture to the whimsical, where every scruffy corner held a hint of magic.

The overall effect is warm and inviting concept art, showcasing the vast phylum of plants with a ravey, almost dreamlike overture, as fiches of light hit a small bruise on their scruffy arm. Sunlight streams with gusto, illuminating dust motes in the air.

The teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls, stands massy, looking upwards towards a solar-powered tripod. An interlocutor, a diffident mullah, gestures at a complex graph of traffic colours, explaining the trickery and wuthering effects of the event.
